entities.title: Typed layer
entities.summary: The 0.3 typed API: CivilDate, CivilTime, ZonedIntent, Instant, Period, Interval and the rest, with Outcome<T> for answers time can refuse.
entities.purpose: Gives each everyday UTV value an immutable Rust type that is valid by construction, with total operations returning plain values and partial ones an Outcome, typed policies, and a TemporalContext that holds the zone rules. Its types are re-exported at the crate root; the module itself is private.
boundaries: Computes nothing itself: every operation calls the JSON layer (src/ops.rs, src/zones.rs, src/text.rs) and reads its answer back.
Holds no rule data and has no default context: the caller loads the rules and passes a TemporalContext.

Values the typed layer has no type for (zoned dates, recurrences, intervals of date-times, values with extra properties) stay in the JSON layer; from_json answers unsupported (unsupported-operand) for them.
